Hey Mixers,
quick question. I got an automatic extension of my A5 and inter visa until end of June. I need to fly to Germany in May and went to Misrad Hapnim to get the stickers in the passport that proof my extension. In general we are in the Haifa branch, but as it was bommed in the war, so we are currently services by the Haifa Krayot branch. Once i got there, they told me they are not giving out stickers for the passport, it is in the system. 

Does anyone have experience with being outside of Israel with an extended visa and coming back after the branches opened again? I am worried that they tell me everything is ok, but once i want to board my flight back with El Al they will require my sticker in the passport. 

Can you guys advise? Thank you so much?
